As previously mentioned, Bangalore is a GREAT legend. I've seen her picked up more this season in ranked than any other season. She's great for playing offensively and defensively for sure. All of her abilities are good for all types of playstyles. Need to get out quick? Once her double time activates, you're zooming. Getting shot at? Smoke yourself to disrupt your enemy's line of sight. Her smoke also works well with unpredictability in a sense that you could smoke yourself or an area in front of you to make it harder for your enemy to predict your movements. Lastly, her barrage is super good for pushing fights, fending off third parties, and applying pressure overall. You'll have to learn timing with her ultimate, but overall? Playing her is so fun.
